title: Tunisian Shrimp Tagine
description: A flavorful and spicy North African-inspired dish made with succulent shrimp, dried fruits, and aromatic spices. Serve over couscous or rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add cumin, cinnamon, harissa, apricots, and prunes.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the flavors have melded together and the shrimp are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
